      Show on map

      Points are placed by mile post along the route, accurate to about a mile. Open Street View from a point to see the exact spot. Each point's popup shows the tampering violations written up at its hot spot on the risk map.

      Roads: Natural Earth. Boundaries: U.S. Census. Places: GeoNames.

      Source: ALGO Tampering Analysis (sms.algogroup.us HOS reports, Mar–Aug 2026; 3,475 reports in total). AZ, OR and AL numbers are estimates: the analysed sample ×4, scaled up to cover all reports. Other states are as recorded. Zones use the sheet's cut-offs: Red ≥ 20% of all violations, Yellow ≥ 10%, Green = some violations, under 10%, Clear = none recorded. Shares show where ALGO trucks were written up, so states we rarely drive through can look safer than they are. Camera lines = places named in inspector notes on an estimated 152 papers from AZ, OR and AL (340 hits): cameras and plate readers in AZ and AL, driver documents (Relay, BOLs, fuel receipts) in OR. The truck list is saved in this browser only.
